title: 3 Star Wars Force Powers You Mix Up
script: This is Force Push. This is Force Repulse. So what's the difference? Force Push directs kinetic force in a single forward line, while Force Repulse unleashes a 360 degree shockwave. This is Jedi Mind Trick. This is Force Persuasion. So what's the difference? Jedi Mind Trick influences weak minds with gentle suggestion, while Force Persuasion forces absolute mental compliance on hostiles. This is Force Lightning. This is Electric Judgement. So what's the difference? Force Lightning is a dark side attack fed by malice, while Electric Judgement is a light side emerald energy strike. Follow for more.
